shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'! .next'"' .; ls -la; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(middleware|proxy)' | head -50; cat package.json"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/middleware.md; rg -n 'Setting Headers|matcher:|all routes|root|nextUrl.pathname|NextResponse.next' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md | head -60; rg --files app; cat tsconfig.json; git status --short"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '410,475p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/proxy.md; sed -n '1,120p' next.config.ts; cat app/page.tsx; cat AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(request.nextUrl.pathname)
+
+  const response = NextResponse.next()
+  response.headers.set('X-Request-Id', randomUUID())
+  return response
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- tsconfig.json; git status --short; cat tsconfig.json; (PORT=3847 npm run start > /tmp/proxy-middleware-next.log 2>&1 & echo $!)'

/bin/bash -c 'cat .gitignore; sleep 1; for path in / /missing; do curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:3847$path" | rg -i '"'"'^(HTTP/|x-request-id:)'"'; done; cat /tmp/proxy-middleware-next.log"

/bin/bash -c "for path in / /missing; do printf '%s\\n' \""'$path"; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:3847$path" | rg -i '"'"'^(HTTP/|x-request-id:)'"'; done; printf 'second request:\\n'; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3847/ | rg -i '"'^(HTTP/|x-request-id:)'"'"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH
find .next -mindepth 1 -depth -delete
rmdir .next
git status --short; git diff -- tsconfig.json; nl -ba proxy.ts"
